codes.condition: Canonical Desktop capability or dependent contract assets cannot be loaded
codes.behavior: Keep channel navigation alive, record local diagnostic, and do not substitute another profile

codes.condition: Selected placement id is absent from the loaded channel capability registry
codes.behavior: Keep the placement selector visible and require an explicit valid placement

codes.condition: A platform-composed placement has no matching source profile
codes.behavior: Do not silently fall back to another source profile

codes.condition: A NAVER FREEFORM placement has no matching implemented Format Profile
codes.behavior: Keep the editor shell alive and block render/export for the unresolved profile

codes.condition: React editor subtree throws during render or lifecycle
codes.behavior: Render an Error Boundary fallback while preserving channel navigation
Swallow the diagnostic write failure and never crash the renderer
